_README: User-flagged DEFINITELY-BAD stills (ground truth) — not fit for use. The calibration set the multi-dimension gate must catch, AND the Half-B reject list (redo clip + remove from cut + reassemble). Flagged 2026-06-17 across two passes; this is the union.

defect_taxonomy.D1_face_eyes: Asymmetric/uneven eyes, divergent or dead gaze, sickly/bruised or grotesque expression that breaks reverence. THE most common miss; the body-only audit ignores faces. (gods-staggering-word, they-shoot-out-the-lip, aimed-at-you, look-at-him, whom-they-pierced, the-shaking-heads)
defect_taxonomy.D2_garbled_text: Garbled/fake lettering on a scroll/book/codex (Hebrew/Greek scribble). (the-greek-word, the-execution-foretold)
defect_taxonomy.D3_frame_border: Wooden picture-frame / triptych side-panels / canvas edge around the painting instead of full-bleed. (isa53_servant_bearing_weight)
defect_taxonomy.D4_wrong_object: Wrong object substituted — a black faceted GEM where an iron nail belongs. (the-marks-of-one)
defect_taxonomy.D5_crowd_face_mush: Secondary/background faces degrade into distortion in crowd scenes. (exiled_nation_column_grey, the-shaking-heads)
defect_taxonomy.D6_body_pose: Standing-not-hanging crucifixion / floating or detached limb (the body-coherence C1-C7 gate already catches these). (the-plan-not-accident, he-had-every-power, the-silent-king, the-jabbing-hands)
defect_taxonomy.D7_hand_fingers: Subtle malformed fingers/melted knuckles on a foreground hand. (the-marks-of-one, the-hand-that-would-not-pull-free)
